instruction: On slide 5, update the font color of the main quote to blue.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to slide 5 (index 4) and changing the main quote/title text font color to blue (RGB: 0, 0, 255). Slide 5 has uppercase quote text 'WRITE AN ORIGINAL STATEMENT OR INSPIRING QUOTE' currently in color 9EEFBC (green). The evaluator identifies title/uppercase text on the slide and verifies all such text colors match blue within tolerance of 20. This allows for minor rendering variations across systems.
